system_description.narrative_summary: A single dominant story ties security escalations, economic friction, and domestic political fallout across East Asia to intensifying US–China strategic competition. The window shows interconnected military signaling (missile launches, drills, Taiwan transits), diplomatic realignments among US allies (South Korea, Japan, Taiwan), and economic strains (tariffs, market mania, Chinese corporate and fiscal stress) that feed back into one another. Treated as an open system, flows of capital, trade, military deterrence, and political signaling cross boundaries and generate reinforcing and balancing feedback loops among states, firms, courts and publics.
system_description.scope: Interactions among the United States, China and regional actors (North Korea, South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, ASEAN) covering security actions, trade and investment, regulatory and judicial decisions, markets and public sentiment.
system_description.super_system: The global geopolitical-economic order (great-power competition and the integrated global economy).
adjacent_subsystems: Global semiconductor supply chain and industrial policy
Chinese domestic political-economy (property sector, courts, fiscal/tax policy)
Regional security architecture and alliance networks (US alliances, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan)
International finance and capital markets (IPOs, foreign investment flows, tariff evasion)

variables.name: Geopolitical tension
variables.description: Degree of strategic rivalry and adversarial posture among major state actors in the region.

variables.name: Military activity intensity
variables.description: Frequency, scale and geographic proximity of military operations, drills, missile tests and transits.

variables.name: Alliance and alignment cohesion
variables.description: Level of diplomatic coordination, policy alignment and cooperative interoperability among partner states.

variables.name: Defense spending trend
variables.description: Rate of change in government military expenditures across the regional system.

variables.name: Economic integration level
variables.description: Degree of cross-border trade, investment, and production interdependence among economies in the region.

variables.name: Trade barrier intensity
variables.description: Prevalence and restrictiveness of tariffs, export controls, investment screening and related trade policy measures.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flows
variables.description: Volume, direction and short-term volatility of international portfolio flows, FDI and other capital movements.

variables.name: Corporate financial stress
variables.description: Prevalence of solvency and liquidity pressures, default risk and distress among large corporate borrowers and issuers.

variables.name: Market volatility
variables.description: Level of price and liquidity volatility across equity, bond and currency markets in the region.

variables.name: Supply chain disruption level
variables.description: Extent of interruptions, rerouting, delays and reliability problems in critical supply chains and logistics networks.

variables.name: Technological competition intensity
variables.description: Degree of competition, restrictions and strategic rivalry in critical technologies and industrial capabilities.

variables.name: Regulatory and judicial enforcement
variables.description: Frequency, scope and severity of regulatory actions, investigations and court rulings affecting economic and security-related activities.

variables.name: Public sentiment toward external actors
variables.description: Aggregate popular attitudes, social support or hostility toward foreign rival actors and external partners.

variables.name: Domestic political polarization
variables.description: Degree of partisan and societal polarization over foreign policy, economic and security choices within societies.

variables.name: Cross-border legal risk
variables.description: Probability and expected magnitude of litigation, asset freezes, bankruptcy adjudication and legal restrictions on cross-border transactions.

variables.name: Information and disinformation flow
variables.description: Rate, reach and targeting of media narratives, strategic communications and disinformation that shape domestic and international perceptions.

catalysts.title: Planned Xi–Trump meeting
catalysts.description: A high‑profile bilateral summit between Xi and Trump currently planned; outcome could materially shift US–China rhetoric, trade friction and military posturing.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'US Navy aircraft transits Taiwan Strait before planned Xi-Trump meeting'.

catalysts.title: Taiwan 2027 defence spending increase
catalysts.description: Taiwan's proposal to raise defence spending by ~18% for 2027 will raise regional military budgets and signaling toward the U.S. and China.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Taiwan proposes boosting 2027 defence spending 18%' and 'Taiwan Floats Record Defense Budget'.

catalysts.title: Renewed North Korea missile launches
catalysts.description: Ongoing DPRK ballistic missile launches tied to exercises and diplomacy cycles are likely to continue near allied drills, raising regional military tensions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'North Korea launches 10 ballistic missiles as US-South Korea drills near end' and 'North Korea launches missile barrage...'.

catalysts.title: Expanded US tariff and enforcement campaign
catalysts.description: US accusations that 40+ countries are helping China evade tariffs indicate an ongoing enforcement push that could broaden trade restrictions and compliance actions.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'US accuses more than 40 countries of helping China avoid Donald Trump’s tariffs'.

catalysts.title: China timely fiscal support to bolster growth
catalysts.description: Beijing's pledge of timely fiscal support to shore up growth may stabilise markets and ease corporate distress, altering regional capital flows and volatility.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'China pledges timely fiscal support to bolster growth'.

catalysts.title: China tax crackdown on wealthy/offshore trusts
catalysts.description: China's tax measures and enforcement against wealthy investors and offshore structures will raise legal and capital-movement risks for cross‑border assets.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'China tax crackdown forces wealthy investors to assess their offshore trusts'.

catalysts.title: South Korea/Japan chip supply‑chain moves
catalysts.description: South Korea's chip investment funds and SK Hynix considering a plant in Japan indicate supply‑chain reshoring and alliance‑aligned industrial shifts in semiconductors.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'South Korea plans chip windfall fund' and 'SK Hynix considers building memory chip plant in Japan'.

catalysts.title: Chinese research/gray‑zone naval activity near Taiwan
catalysts.description: Repeated Chinese research and surveillance vessels operating close to Taiwan are likely to continue, prompting Taiwanese warnings and military responses.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Taiwan warns off, shadows Chinese research ship sailing to its west'.

catalysts.title: Heightened FDI screening and probes
catalysts.description: EU probe into a Chinese bid and public pushback suggest broader investment screening and legal scrutiny of China‑linked deals in allied markets.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'China hits out at EU probe into JD.com bid for German retailer'.

catalysts.title: YMTC parent Shanghai IPO
catalysts.description: A large Shanghai IPO by a Chinese flash‑memory maker's parent company will influence capital flows, investor sentiment and China tech capacity visibility.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Chinese flash‑memory chipmaker YMTC parent targets $4.9 billion in Shanghai IPO'.
